title: LCPNet: Latent Consistent Proximal Unfolding Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
abstract: arXiv:2607.04603v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Infrared small target detection (IRSTD) aims to identify long distance small targets from complex infrared backgrounds, and is a fundamental task in remote sensing. Deep learning methods have improved IRSTD by learning discriminative image-to-mask mappings, but such feed-forward designs often underuse physical decomposition structure between targets and backgrounds. Deep unfolding methods partially address this issue by embedding model-driven iterations into neural networks, yet existing designs still operate mainly in image domain and use updates and memory mechanisms that are not fully coupled with underlying optimization process. To address these limitations, we propose Latent Consistent Proximal unfolding network (LCPNet). First, we verify that low-rank prior remains valid in latent representations and perform unfolding in this space, preserving physical constraint while avoiding repeated compression of intermediate states.

translated_title: LCPNet：用于红外小目标检测的潜在一致近端展开网络
translated_abstract: 红外小目标检测（IRSTD）旨在从复杂的红外背景中识别远距离小目标，是遥感领域的一项基础任务。深度学习方法通过学习判别性的图像到掩码映射提升了红外小目标检测的性能，但这类前馈式设计往往未能充分利用目标与背景之间的物理分解结构。深度展开方法通过将模型驱动的迭代嵌入神经网络，部分解决了这一问题，然而现有设计主要仍在图像域中运行，且所采用的更新与记忆机制未能与底层优化过程完全耦合。为解决这些局限，我们提出了潜在一致近端展开网络。首先，我们验证了低秩先验在潜在表示中依然有效，并在该空间中执行展开，从而在保持物理约束的同时避免了中间状态的反复压缩。
tldr: 提出LCPNet，通过验证低秩先验在潜在表示中依然有效并在该潜在空间中执行近端展开，在保持物理约束的同时避免了中间状态的反复压缩，从而提升红外小目标检测性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes LCPNet, which verifies that the low-rank prior remains valid in latent representations and performs proximal unfolding in this space, preserving physical constraints while avoiding repeated compression of intermediate states to improve infrared small target detection.
